title: Insure residential building work (home warranty)
what: Take out home warranty (home building compensation) insurance for residential building work before starting, and give the owner the certificate.

sources.title: Building Work Contractors Act 1995 (SA)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A building work contractor must not perform building work to which this Division applies unless— (a) a policy of insurance that complies with this Division is in force in relation to that building work;

triggers.note: Above a contract value set by regulation (not yet quoted).

assessment.summary: Residential building work over a set value needs home warranty insurance, which builders can buy only once an insurer accepts them.

marks.reason: A new builder needs an insurer's eligibility (often set by net assets and track record) before contracting.
